messages:
ashwin: Quick sync — need to lock down storefront assets + EULA quirks for AWS/GCP/Azure before tomorrow's kickoff. Main blockers: hero image sizes, trial SKU mapping, entitlements, and legal contact. Who can help?

jordan: I can take the assets side. Do we have a single ZIP with icons/tiles + one hero per cloud? Also need the copy for the hero CTA (try vs demo).

clare: Azure has an extra publisher agreement step and enforces 1024x512 hero gfx. AWS prefers 1200x628, GCP often shows 1280x720 in storefront previews (we saw cropping issues last time).

samir: Trials: AWS expects a marketplace SKU tied to a metered plan, GCP uses a trial plan flag + region mapping, Azure requires plan mapping in the offer manifest. We should map: SKUs -> plan_name -> entitlements table. I'll draft mapping.

ashwin: @samir please post the CSV mapping here when ready. Jordan — can you confirm tile filenames + sizes by EOD?

jordan: Yup. I'll upload a ZIP to the publisher bucket. One ask: can we keep the CTA copy as a short verb phrase ("Start free trial", "Request demo") not sentences — storefront truncates at ~28 chars.

clare: Also: image alt text + short description for accessibility — Azure surface shows alt as tooltip. Keep alt <= 60 chars.

marta: Legal flag: we need localized EULAs for FR/DE/ES and an EU VAT clause for paid plans. Send the draft to legal@redwood.com. Also confirm whether trial enrollments collect billing info (AWS/GCP differ).

samir: CSV mapping draft uploaded: s3://redwood-pub/onboard/sku-mapping-176234.csv — columns: cloud, sku_id, plan_name, trial_length_days, region_exceptions. Note: Azure has CA/US restrictions for a particular SKU.

publisher-bot: Artifact check OK — uploaded ZIP is 14.2MB, under 50MB limit. Preflight: images: hero_aws.png(1200x628), hero_gcp.png(1280x720), hero_azure.png(1024x512), logos: svg + png, manifest.json included.

jordan: Terraform snippet for automated upload if anyone wants it:
```
resource "aws_s3_bucket_object" "pub_assets" {
  bucket = "redwood-pub"
  key    = "onboard/${var.publish_id}/assets.zip"
  source = "./assets.zip"
}
```

clare: Who owns the publisher portal roles? We need someone to be Owner on each cloud listing to finish the final step.

ashwin: I'll be Owner for AWS and GCP temporarily. Clare — can you take Azure Owner for the initial go-live?

clare: Yep I can. I'll schedule a short handoff with platform ops to confirm access.

marta: I'll queue the EULA localization task with legal and attach the tax clause template. Expect reply by EOD tomorrow.

samir: One more technical note — KV cache enabled flag needs to be disabled in the AMI SKU metadata (AWS) to avoid startup throttles on first run. I added a comment in the CSV.

jordan: Great. Plan: assets + manifest final by 5pm PT, legal check in by EOD tomorrow, publisher role handoff today. If we hit blockers ping me and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
